messages:
Carmen Vega: Opening a relnotes + whats-new draft for the runtime tweaks (batching presets + KV cache housekeeping). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6021
Ibrahim Khan: Nice — paste the TL;DR bullets and I'll polish wording and add SDK snippets.
Carmen Vega: TL;DR: 1) New presets: interactive-low-latency, throughput-balanced, saver-1. 2) KV cache: lower memory use and better prefix reuse. 3) Router prefers same-region replicas to reduce p99. Known caveat: canary dashboards may underreport latency briefly while caches warm.
Ibrahim Khan: Draft SDK snippets (Python + JS):
```
# Python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
client.routes.update('checkout-flow', batching_preset='interactive-low-latency')
```
```
// JavaScript
await client.routes.update('checkout-flow', { batchingPreset: 'interactive-low-latency' })
```
Soren Lee: Add a dedicated pool example and ops note: `poolConfig: { batchingPreset: 'throughput-balanced' }` and "restart GPU workers or recycle long-lived processes to pick up new presets."
Megan Wu: For Known Issues please use this exact line: "Enabling presets on legacy routes can cause transient p50/p95 spikes for ~1-3 minutes while continuous-batch windows and KV caches rebalance. Canary dashboards may underreport latency during this period." Link to incident: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-2890
docs-bot: Reminder: add a whats-new markdown under /docs/whats-new with frontmatter. Example:

date: 2025-07-10
title: "Batching presets & KV cache housekeeping"
components: [runtime, routing]
---

Carmen Vega: Thanks — I'll add the frontmatter and the short whats-new blurb, Ibrahim can you drop the snippets into the PR and Soren add the pool example? If CI passes I'll merge and ping eng-oncall at merge for the first 30m.
